newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BBL buys Amerbank stake from Bankers Trust unit. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BBL buys Amerbank stake from Bankers Trust unit. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: Belgian Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL) said in a statement on Tuesday it bought a stake in Polish Amerbank from Bankers Trust unit HAC.
The transaction boosted BBL's stake to 36.44 percent of Amerbank's capital from 30 percent, and to 20 percent of the voting rights from 16 percent.
(Corrects to make clear that BBL boosts its voting stake to 20 percent from 16 percent).
Amerbank, founded in 1989, is the first bank in Poland founded with foreign capital. It employs 170 people and is headquartered in Warsaw.
In terms of assets it is Poland 28th-biggest commercial bank with a balance sheet total of 450 million zloty.
Besides its stake in Amerbank, BBL has a representative office in Warsaw and a stake in MC Concordia, the Polish unit of MC-BBL Eastern European (Holdings).
